image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large, oblong meatloaf resting on a dark wooden surface. The loaf has been sliced at the front, revealing a dense interior texture with visible flecks of green herbs/vegetables and small red pieces (likely peppers or tomatoes). The exterior crust is browned and textured, appearing slightly dry rather than heavily glazed. A white cloth napkin is visible in the upper left background, and a glass jar is partially visible in the upper right.
